volunteering.title: Skate Guard
volunteering.description: This position entailed assisting skating instructors in teaching children how to skate and scanning the ice for any hazards or risks to personal and customer safety.

volunteering.title: Mathematics Peer Mentor
volunteering.description: This role entails meeting with first-year students interested in pursuing a mathematics degree and mentoring them through MATH 1120. This introductory math course aims to establish the foundations of mathematical maturity by shifting the framework of problem solving from computational to formal logic and rigorous proof-based solutions.
